A '''cooking stone''' was a part of survival gear, intended to be set in or held over a fire to cook food without burning it. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] once used one to hold damp sand, which he shot with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] to catch the [[Water/Legends|water]] vapor on a face mask he held above the stone in order to drink and survive in a [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] sandstorm.<ref name="TG">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref>
